dossier.scp_unleashed.337.title: The Hair Mass
dossier.scp_unleashed.337.caption: SCP-337 in the root cellar where it was found, photographed from the hatch.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-337 is to be kept in a standard holding cell with solid walls and a door that latches. The viewing hatch is to remain shuttered while the cell is occupied, and observation is by camera only.
**Personnel are not to stand within eight metres of SCP-337 in plain view of it.**
Loose hair found anywhere in the containment wing is to be collected, bagged and logged.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-337 is a mass of tangled hair a little over two metres across and around one and a half metres high. It is mostly black and dark brown, with a few strands of grey and red-brown running through it. Long loose locks hang from every side of it and sway even when the air is still. No body, bone or organ has ever been found inside it. Every scan shows only more hair, packed tighter toward the middle.
SCP-337 moves by rolling and dragging itself across the floor. It is very slow, and it has never been seen to climb.

When a person comes within several metres of it, cords of hair lash out from deep inside the mass, strike, and draw back in under a second. Struck personnel describe a burning sting and a sharp pull toward the mass. It does not react to animals in the same way.

page.title: Addendum 337-1: Recovery
page.text: SCP-337 was found filling most of a root cellar beneath an abandoned smallholding. The family who had lived there could not be traced. A farmhand who had gone down for preserves reported only that "the dark in the corner moved".

page.title: Addendum 337-2: Observations
text: A barn cat left in the test cell for an hour was ignored entirely, even after it scratched at SCP-337. D-9112, entering the same cell the next morning, was struck before the door had finished opening.
After an incident, SCP-337 settles and goes quiet for a time. %rThe length of that time is not recorded here.%r

page.title: Addendum 337-3: Note
page.text: Night staff report a soft, steady rustling from the cell at all hours. %rIt grows louder when someone stands outside the door.%r

death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp337_lash.p: %1$s was lashed to death while fighting %2$s
SCP-337: a heaving mound of tangled dark hair, a little over two metres across. Loose locks sway from it even when the air is still.
It lashes out at people with whips of hair that shoot from somewhere deep inside it. It pays no attention to villagers or animals, whatever they do to it.
It drags itself along very slowly. Its file in the Archive says more about where it was found.
